briefs.headline: Your discoveries live in Threads
briefs.body: When the world teaches you a changed rule, a small Threads reminder appears. Press the shown key — M by default — to read the rule and its evidence.

briefs.headline: Recipes obey this world
briefs.body: Familiar recipes are often intentionally different or gated. Treat EMI as the local authority, then follow machines and materials backward until you find the first reachable step.

briefs.headline: Sleep advances the world
briefs.body: A bed is not a frozen checkpoint. Sleeping advances simulated time and may move weather, temperature, ecology, and active threats before you wake safely again.

briefs.headline: Clear water is earned
briefs.body: Thirst and water purity are separate constraints. Inspect the source, improve it when necessary, and keep a reliably purified reserve before distance turns uncertainty into danger.

briefs.headline: Full is not nourished
briefs.body: Hunger measures immediate fuel, while nutrition rewards a varied diet over time. Repeating one excellent meal can still leave important food groups dangerously neglected afterward.

briefs.headline: Food carries weather
briefs.body: Meals can carry thermal state as well as nutrition. Save warming and cooling foods for the conditions where their temperature matters, not merely when hunger appears.

briefs.headline: Tools are learned systems
briefs.body: Early tools are assembled from parts whose materials change behavior. Read each component, repair what you understand, and expect improvement to come through construction rather than replacement.

briefs.headline: Rotation is a budget
briefs.body: Create networks spend stress capacity and transmit speed through ratios. Diagnose stalled machines from the source outward: generation, direction, gearing, remaining capacity, then the working endpoint.

briefs.headline: Machines have roots
briefs.body: Automation chains are dependency trees, not isolated recipes. Find the earliest resource, energy, pressure, or crafting boundary you can satisfy and build forward from that root.

briefs.headline: Coins do not climb tiers
briefs.body: Currency is meant to move through authored trades, not convert freely into a universal higher tier. Learn who accepts each coin before treating it as progression.

briefs.headline: The End is not a door
briefs.body: Vanilla eyes and portals do not define every route here. Dimension access follows the pack's authored paths; blocked landmarks are instructions to seek another doorway.

briefs.headline: Defeat is not erasure
briefs.body: Falling may begin a recoverable downed state before death. Read the rescue window, protect the body, and remember that lineage can preserve knowledge across a successor.
